question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'
sql:
WITH event_params AS (
  SELECT 
    event_name,
    event_timestamp,
    event_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END) AS ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS medium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'campaign' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key IN ('ga_session_id', 'medium', 'source', 'campaign')
  GROUP BY event_name, event_timestamp, event_date
),
session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(medium) AS medium,
    MAX(source) AS source,
    MAX(campaign) AS campaign
  FROM event_params
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    COALESCE(medium, '') AS medium,
    COALESCE(source, '') AS source,
    COALESCE(campaign, '') AS campaign,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), '^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), '^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), '^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), '^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$')
            OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media')) THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(video).*)$'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
            OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
            OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')) THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC

      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), '^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$'))
